audience: Shopify merchants who sell subscriptions with Joy Subscriptions

useCases.title: Find subscribers with failed payments
useCases.text: List the orders that wait for a billing retry and read the dunning overview. See the subscribers with an invalid payment method, then decide who to follow up with.

useCases.title: Review subscription revenue and churn
useCases.text: Read revenue, orders and average order value for a date range. Check the churn rate, the churned MRR and the retention cohorts by signup month.

useCases.title: Look up a subscriber and their subscriptions
useCases.text: Search subscriptions by customer name or email. Open one subscription to see its status, plan, next billing date and payment.

useCases.title: Plan the upcoming orders
useCases.text: List the orders that are not billed yet, soonest first, and the recurring orders already billed. Read the subscription plans and the products that have a subscription option.

useCases.title: Pause, resume or skip a subscriber's order
useCases.text: Pause an active subscription for a customer who asks for a break, or resume a paused one. Skip the next scheduled order. Each change updates the live shop.
